classification.Preserved: All required public-language and approved carrier observations for the case are established with an attributable witness.
classification.Violated: At least one required observation differs, with a witness naming the observable and actual result.
classification.Unknown: Identity, execution, parsing, extraction, dependency, opacity, or budget prevents a sound decision. Unknown is fail-closed and cannot satisfy a mandatory case or reject a mutation.

observables.O-BINDING: math.frac is a callable function in the closed math module and produces the canonical MathFrac identity rather than a textual slash or generic sequence.
observables.O-SIGNATURE: The qualified function requires num then denom positionally, accepts only style as named, rejects missing, extra, positional-as-named, duplicate and unknown arguments, coerces Content/string/none to content, and rejects integers with the measured public fragments.
observables.O-STYLE-EXPLICITNESS: Omitted style is stored as None and omitted from repr; each explicit vertical, skewed or horizontal value is stored as Some(style) and printed, including explicit vertical.
observables.O-SET-PRECEDENCE: Effective style is element-explicit, then cascaded math.frac.style, then Vertical. The set rule accepts only the three canonical strings; binom never consumes it.
observables.O-BARE-CONVERGENCE: Bare frac(a,b), slash a/b, and qualified math.frac([a],[b]) converge on the same vertical MathFrac carrier and public result except for slash-only causal deparenthesization bits.
observables.O-SLASH-ASSOCIATIVITY: a/b/c associates to the left as frac(frac(a,b),c), preserving the nested carrier rather than flattening or right-associating.
observables.O-DEPARENTHESIZATION: Only slash syntax transports the numerator and denominator was_deparenthesized bits from the AST. One removed outer pair sets the corresponding bit; an additional inner pair remains content. The bits affect only horizontal protection morphology and are omitted from repr.
observables.O-CARRIER: MathFrac stores num, denom, optional explicit MathFracStyle, num_deparenthesized, denom_deparenthesized and line. Public fractions have line=true; binom has line=false and no public style inheritance.
observables.O-WALKERS: Clone, structural equality, hash, map_content and terminal map_text preserve style, both deparenthesization bits and line. map_content recurses only through num and denom; plain_text remains value-based.
observables.O-OBSERVATION-RELATION: ObservationEq compares num, denom, optional style, both deparenthesization bits and line. Any differing causal field is Different symmetrically, never normalized to Same or Unproven.
observables.O-REPR: Public line=true repr is frac(num: ..., denom: ...) with style appended only when explicitly present. It never exposes causal bits. Canonical line=false binom recognition remains prior and does not gain style.
observables.O-RECONSTRUCTION: apply_math_default and apply_math_style preserve optional style, both causal bits and line without normalization. Effective style resolution does not rewrite the stored explicitness.
observables.O-LAYOUT-VERTICAL: Effective Vertical uses the established stacked numerator-over-denominator algorithm with a horizontal rule for line=true and preserves the existing barless stack for line=false.
observables.O-LAYOUT-SKEWED: Effective Skewed places numerator above-left and denominator below-right around an inclined extensible slash, uses AxisHeight plus the two skewed-fraction gap constants, and contains no horizontal fraction rule.
observables.O-LAYOUT-HORIZONTAL: Effective Horizontal orders numerator, slash and denominator on one line and restores protective parentheses for each slash operand whose outer pair was removed, without manufacturing protection for an unmarked operand.
observables.O-MATH-CONSTANTS: MathConstants contains independent skewed_fraction_vertical_gap and skewed_fraction_horizontal_gap values in design units. Fallback is exactly 96 and 350; NewCMMath extraction yields those entries, preserves a present zero, and never derives one from axis or rule thickness.
observables.O-BINOM-CONTROL: math.binom remains a line=false vertical stack enclosed by parentheses, contains neither fraction bar nor slash, and is unaffected by explicit or cascaded math.frac.style.
observables.O-FAIL-CLOSED: Identity mismatch, opaque construction or extraction, unsupported observation, unreadable output, timeout, crash, OOM, swap, missing dependency or exhausted budget is Unknown and blocks mandatory acceptance.

exhaustive_wiring.fail_closed: Any additional productive consumer, non-mechanical existing-test repair, wildcard suppressing review, missing owner L0, or change outside the twelve-consumer allowlist invalidates admission until obligation authority reviews the expanded surface.

gates.preseal: Manifest, contract, oracle suite, mutation suite, executor bindings, hashes, and three execution orders are frozen before candidate admission.

claim_boundary: This contract discriminates only the approved P1427 math.frac fragment. It does not establish general math parity, authorize another math route, require render-byte equality, or grant credit for Rust representation or operation order.
